title: Tech Note: Preserving display state with Save Geometry
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Save Geometry addressed a genuinely persistent developer pain point — manually saving/restoring form and object states — and the feature itself, along with the underlying window-bounds JSON preference file mechanism, has remained part of 4D's form engine for over a decade. The specific file-path locations described (tied to the classic binary structure's per-database Windows/Mac cache folders) reflect Design Mode-era conventions, but the feature's behavior carries over largely unchanged into Project Mode. This is a durable, still-used piece of the platform rather than something that was replaced by a new architecture.
related_updates: Project Mode (4D v17+, 2018) changed how forms themselves are stored (as JSON .4DForm files) but the Save Geometry/Save Value runtime behavior described here is unaffected
